scope: Exactly shipped fixed 36 / 37 outer tooth surfaces; no gum, papilla, bone, or brush geometry in these measurements. Source setup is an education illustration, not a measured individual or a clinical size recommendation. World cm = manifest.matrix after same-arch corrections, lower jaw y minus 0.48cm once; 10 mm/cm. No models or runtime modified.
closestMethod: Shortest candidate from opposing vertex-to-triangle queries followed by alternating closest-point projection from 36 best seeds. Geometry is separated by a small gap, so contact means closest proximal site; no actual touching.

path.units: World control points cm in the fixed displayed jaw, arc coordinates mm measured from buccal start toward lingual exit.
path.type: Single rigid straight line, no stretching, piecewise bending or tooth movement.
path.opposingSurfaceRayDefinition: For each slice along buccal direction, ray independently through tooth36 from distal and37 from mesial; where both boundaries exist, measure difference along distal direction only. Oblique hard gap is not Euclidean wire clearance.

rigidEnvelope.certificate: Distance to a closed surface is 1-Lipschitz. All points on the straight segment lie within at most half one dense sample spacing, subtract that from sampled minimum plus 0.0003mm numerical reserve. This certifies a conservative swept capsule radius against BOTH hard-tooth mesh LODs. It is not a soft tissue safety certificate.

softBristleExample.meaning: Only where a full-radius illustrative cylindrical bristle envelope can reach the hard surfaces. Deflect individual bristles against sampled local surfaces; taper and axial phase may reduce actual contact. A 1.2mm rigid tube does not fit this path. No universal/clinical brush size implied.

path.ferruleRule: Keep thick sleeve/ferrule nose (its foremost centerline station) at or buccal to maxNoseCenterArcMm for chosen component diameter; sleeve trails behind. Stops computed with 0.08mm radius allowance plus conservative first-bilateral-wall limit. Never scale the sleeve to thread through the corridor. Negative arc is permitted before entry.
